questions.q: Where do about half of elite college graduates go, per the summary?
a: Finance, law or consulting
Teaching, medicine or government
Startups, nonprofits or the arts
Manufacturing, farming or retail
questions.why: Lesson 1 says roughly 40 percent enter finance or consulting and 13 percent go to law.

questions.q: What mainly draws students into those fields?
a: High pay and the status that comes with it
Steady hours and generous vacation time
A strong desire to serve the public
The chance to travel and live abroad
questions.why: Lesson 1 names money and status as the main pull.

questions.q: Why are these firms hard to stay in?
a: Long hours, travel and an up-or-out culture
Low pay and very few benefits
Boring work with no real challenge
Too much independence and freedom

questions.q: What does the summary say about job growth?
a: All net new jobs come from new companies
Large firms create most new jobs
Government hiring drives most growth
Job growth is spread evenly across firms
